stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Korg befriends Thor in the gladiator pits of Sakaar and joins his revolt against the Grandmaster.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend from the pits whose revolt Korg joins.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend from the pits who joins Thor's revolt.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Korg follows Thor to New Asgard and fights at his side again against Gorr, even after Zeus blasts his body apart.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Korg's friend, whom he follows to New Asgard and fights beside.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's friend, who fights beside him against Gorr even after losing his body.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Korg keeps Thor company in New Asgard through five years of despair, and Thor threatens an online gamer who insults him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The friend whose house Korg shares in New Asgard. Threatens a gamer who insults him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who keeps Thor company through five dark years in New Asgard.

their_evidence: In Thor's house in New Asgard Korg plays video games and keeps Thor company; when NoobMaster69 insults Korg, Thor threatens the player; Korg warns Banner not to say Thanos's name around Thor.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff interrogates Loki in his cell on the Helicarrier, where he taunts her about Clint and her past. She tricks him into revealing that he plans to unleash the Hulk.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The spy who tricks Loki into revealing his plan for the Hulk.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The prisoner Natasha interrogates and tricks into revealing his plan.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: After Loki's defeat in New York, Natasha takes charge of his scepter in Stark Tower while he sits captured among the Avengers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger who takes Loki's scepter after his defeat.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The captured god whose scepter Natasha takes.

their_evidence: 2012 New York heist: with Loki defeated and held at arrow point by Clint in Stark Tower, Natasha takes Loki's scepter and later hands it to Sitwell.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki is the first enemy Steve Rogers faces as an Avenger, dueling him in Stuttgart and leading the Chitauri invasion of New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The soldier Loki duels in Stuttgart.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's first enemy as an Avenger.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Captured after the Battle of New York, Loki mocks Steve in Stark Tower before Thor gags him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A captor Loki mocks after his defeat in New York.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The captive god who mocks Steve after the Battle of New York.

their_evidence: 2012 New York heist: Loki is apprehended by the Avengers and mocks Captain America before Thor gags him with a collar.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Loki tries to take control of Tony Stark with his scepter, but Tony's arc reactor blocks it, so Loki throws him out of Stark Tower. Tony then leads the fight against Loki's invasion of New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The man Loki throws out of Stark Tower, who leads the fight against him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The god who throws Tony out of Stark Tower.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Tony escorts the captured Loki out of Stark Tower while carrying the Tesseract. When the case falls in the chaos of Tony's heist, Loki grabs the Tesseract and escapes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A captor whose dropped Tesseract Loki grabs to escape.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The captive god who escapes with the Tesseract Tony loses.

their_evidence: 2012 New York heist: Tony and Thor escort Loki to the lobby with Tony holding the Tesseract case; the present-day Stark and Lang's attempt to steal it fails, the case slides to Loki's feet and he escapes with it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula and Mantis meet on Ego's planet, where Mantis tells her and Gamora about Ego's dead children. They then fight on the same side against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister, who fights beside Mantis against Ego.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives with Ego and fights beside Nebula against him.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Mantis rejoins Nebula and the other Guardians on the Benatar, and both cheer on a fight when Thor and Quill argue over who leads.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate back on the Benatar, who joins in the banter over who leads.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate back on the Benatar, who joins in the banter over who leads.

their_evidence: After the funeral, Nebula rejoins the Guardians (Rocket, Drax, Mantis, Groot, Quill) on the Benatar; Thor and Quill quarrel over leadership and Nebula and Mantis join in suggesting a fight.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis joins the Guardians after Ego's defeat, and when she first sees Rocket she thinks he is a pet and asks to pat him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis mistakes for a pet and asks to pat.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new teammate who mistakes Rocket for a pet.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Back aboard the Benatar with Thor, Mantis eagerly backs Rocket's offer of knives when Thor and Quill argue over who leads.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate whose offer of knives Mantis eagerly backs.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who eagerly backs Rocket's offer of knives.

their_evidence: On the Benatar Rocket says 'I got some blasters unless you guys want to use knives?' and Mantis replies 'Oh, yes, please use knives.'

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nebula is one of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing Gamora and Quill across the galaxy for the Orb.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A thief Nebula chases across the galaxy for the Orb.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing Quill and Gamora for the Orb.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula comes after Gamora again on Ego's planet, but she ends up fighting beside Quill and the Guardians against Ego before leaving to hunt Thanos.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's teammate, whom Nebula fights beside against Ego.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gamora's sister, who fights beside Quill against Ego, then leaves.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Nebula joins the fight against Thanos on Titan, and her revelation that Thanos killed Gamora sends Quill into a rage.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An ally on Titan, whom Nebula's news about Gamora sends into a rage.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An ally on Titan who reveals Thanos killed Gamora.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: On Morag in 2014, Nebula and Rhodes knock out a younger Quill and take the Power Stone before he can reach it. In the battle against Thanos, a past Gamora knocks Quill down and he turns to Nebula, confused.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A younger version of him is knocked out on Morag so Nebula can take the Power Stone.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Knocks out his younger self on Morag to take the Power Stone.

their_evidence: 2014 Morag: Nebula and Rhodes wait for Quill, knock him out and collect the Power Stone; in the Battle of Earth Quill looks to Nebula in confusion after the 2014 Gamora rejects him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned Leeds is Peter Parker's best friend from school. Once he learns Peter's secret, he helps him from behind a computer as his guy in the chair.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, whose guy in the chair he becomes.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend and guy in the chair.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Ned helps Peter face the villains from other worlds. To save the world, Peter has everyone forget him, and Ned says a tearful goodbye to his best friend.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, who erases himself from everyone's memory. Ned says a tearful goodbye.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, who helps him face the villains, then forgets him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Years later Ned, who no longer remembers Peter, tracks Spider-Man's sightings with an app he built. He finally meets the hero face to face, and then meets Peter again.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's forgotten best friend. Ned tracks his Spider-Man sightings, then meets him again.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's forgotten best friend, who tracks Spider-Man with an app he built.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Back after five years gone, Ned spots Peter at school and the two best friends share an emotional reunion.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, reunited with him at school after the Blip.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, who runs to him at school after the Blip.

their_evidence: After the Blip, on the first day of the new school year, Ned sees Peter and they have an emotional reunion.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye guards Shuri, and the two tease T'Challa together like family.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The princess Okoye guards, and her partner in teasing T'Challa.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's guard, and her partner in teasing T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: When Shuri is taken by the Talokanil on Okoye's watch, Okoye loses her rank, but she returns to fight beside Shuri as a Midnight Angel in the war against Talokan.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The princess taken on Okoye's watch, whom she later fights beside.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shuri's old guard, who loses her rank, then fights beside her as Midnight Angel.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: When Shuri returns from the Blip, Okoye is reunited with her and walks beside her and T'Challa through a sorcerer's portal to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Returns from the Blip and marches into battle at Okoye's side.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Reunited with Shuri after the Blip, she leads Wakanda's army beside her.

their_evidence: After the Blip, Okoye is reunited with T'Challa and Shuri; alongside them she walks through a portal and leads the Wakandan armies into the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje, the king's guard, and is T'Challa's closest protector. When Killmonger takes the throne she stays loyal to it at first, then joins T'Challa when he returns to win it back.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king and charge. She returns to his side to win back the throne.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's closest protector and leader of the Dora Milaje.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Okoye weeps as she helps carry his casket at his funeral.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, whose casket she helps carry when he dies of an illness.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's closest protector, who helps carry his casket at his funeral.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: When T'Challa returns from the Blip, Okoye is at his side again, and they walk through a sorcerer's portal together to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Okoye's king, back from the Blip. She leads his army into battle beside him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's general, back at his side to lead Wakanda's army against Thanos.

their_evidence: After the Blip, Okoye is reunited with her king; with T'Challa and Shuri she walks through a portal and leads the Wakandan armies into the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot first try to collect the bounty on Peter Quill, and the three end up founding the Guardians of the Galaxy together. Quill and Rocket bicker constantly but become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A bounty hunter turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A bounty turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians' desperate mission to save Rocket's life, and afterward he hands Rocket leadership of the team before going home to Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Quill's close friend, whose life he fights to save, and to whom he hands the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's close friend, who saves his life and hands him the team.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Reunited after the Blip, Rocket and Quill mourn Tony with the Guardians. When Thor joins them on the Benatar and questions Quill's leadership, Rocket offers blasters to settle it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Back with Quill after the Blip. Offers blasters when Thor questions his leadership.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Back with Rocket after the Blip, defending his place as the Guardians' leader.

their_evidence: Rocket attends Tony's funeral with the reunited Guardians; on the Benatar, during Thor and Quill's squabble over leadership, Rocket says he has blasters they could use.

question: Fury and Hill appear in Endgame only at Tony's funeral, after he dies (they hear his recorded message with everyone else). Should attending someone's funeral count as a stage between them?

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: On Titan, Quill and Stephen Strange first face off, each thinking the other works for Thanos, then join forces to ambush him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A sorcerer Quill first suspects, then joins against Thanos.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Strange first suspects, then joins to ambush Thanos.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Restored on Titan, Quill steps through the portal Stephen Strange opens to Earth and joins the battle against Thanos's army.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer whose portal takes Quill from Titan to the battle.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Strange brings from Titan to the battle.

their_evidence: After the Blip is undone, Strange enlists the restored Guardians and Spider-Man on Titan and opens a portal that brings them to the ruins of the Avengers Compound for the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill feels threatened when the Guardians pick Thor up in space and starts deepening his voice to compete.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The god whose arrival makes Quill feel threatened.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian who deepens his voice to compete with Thor.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: After the war with Thanos, Thor travels with the Guardians, and the two part as friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who travels with Quill's Guardians, then parts on good terms.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Thor travels with after the war with Thanos.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Thor joins the Guardians aboard the Benatar, and Quill reminds him that it is still his ship and he is in charge. Thor agrees, and they laugh off the idea of fighting for the lead.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Quill's Guardians, and agrees Quill is in charge.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Guardian who tells Thor the ship is still his.

their_evidence: Quill picks Thor up at New Asgard; on the Benatar he moves Thor's hand off the map and says 'this is my ship still. I'm in charge', Thor answers 'Of course you are', and the team's suggestion they fight for leadership is laughed off.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Wong is the librarian of Kamar-Taj who helps teach Stephen Strange, and they become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kamar-Taj's librarian. Helps teach Strange and becomes a close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's student, who becomes a close friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: While Strange is lost in the Blip, Wong takes over as Sorcerer Supreme, and he warns Strange against casting the spell to make the world forget Peter Parker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Strange's friend and the new Sorcerer Supreme. Warns Strange against the spell.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wong's friend. Wong warns him against the spell to make the world forget Peter.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Wong brings the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj and allies from across the universe through portals to fight Thanos's army. When Strange asks if that is everyone, Wong asks whether he wanted more.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Brings the sorcerers to the battle beside Strange.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend who asks Wong if that is everyone.

their_evidence: At the Battle of Earth, Strange meets Wong after the portals open: 'Is that everyone?' 'What, you wanted more?' They later stand side by side at Tony's funeral.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Challa hunts Bucky Barnes for his father's murder and fights Steve Rogers to get to him in Bucharest and Leipzig. Once he learns Zemo was the killer, he brings Steve and Bucky to Wakanda and gives Bucky asylum.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Steve to get to Bucky, then learns the truth and gives Bucky asylum.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Stands between T'Challa and Bucky, then finds shelter for Bucky in Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Having learned that Zemo was behind his father's death, T'Challa shelters Steve and Bucky in Wakanda, and they fight side by side when Thanos' army invades.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Wakanda's king. Shelters Steve and Bucky, and fights beside Steve against Thanos's army.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An ally T'Challa shelters in Wakanda and fights beside against Thanos.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: T'Challa leads Wakanda's armies through a portal to the ruined Avengers Compound, sharing a look with a battered Steve Rogers, then joins the charge Steve leads against Thanos's army.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Wakanda's king, whose arrival through a portal relieves Steve.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The battered leader T'Challa joins in the charge against Thanos.

their_evidence: T'Challa, Shuri and Okoye walk out of a portal; he shares a glance with a battle-weary Steve, who shows relief, and T'Challa joins the charge after Steve rallies everyone.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: At the airport battle, Wanda stops T'Challa's claws just short of Bucky's throat and throws him aside.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The witch who stops T'Challa's claws short of Bucky's throat.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A king whose claws Wanda stops short of Bucky's throat.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Two years later, T'Challa's Wakanda shelters Wanda and Vision as the Avengers make their stand against Thanos.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger T'Challa's kingdom shelters against Thanos.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wakanda's king, who shelters Wanda and Vision.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: As T'Challa runs with the gauntlet, Thanos charges at him, and Wanda blocks his path and takes Thanos on so T'Challa can get away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The witch who blocks Thanos's charge at T'Challa.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The king Wanda saves from Thanos's charge.

their_evidence: Barton passes the gauntlet to Black Panther; as Thanos prepares to charge at T'Challa, his path is blocked by Wanda, who engages Thanos while T'Challa runs.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill feels threatened when the Guardians pick Thor up in space and starts deepening his voice to compete.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The god whose arrival makes Quill feel threatened.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian who deepens his voice to compete with Thor.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: After the war with Thanos, Thor travels with the Guardians, and the two part as friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who travels with Quill's Guardians, then parts on good terms.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Thor travels with after the war with Thanos.

question: Thor joins Quill's Guardians and they spar over who leads. Ally (now teammates) or keep rival (the leadership contest from Infinity War continues)?

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos' army invades Wakanda for the Mind Stone, and T'Challa leads his people against it. When T'Challa attacks him, Thanos grabs him and knocks him out with a single punch, and T'Challa turns to dust when Thanos snaps.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Titan who invades Wakanda and turns T'Challa to dust.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The king of Wakanda, who stands in Thanos's way.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: As T'Challa runs for the van with the gauntlet, Thanos knocks him down with his sword and charges at him, until Wanda blocks his path.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Knocks T'Challa down with his sword to take back the gauntlet.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Runs with the gauntlet until Thanos knocks him down with his sword.

their_evidence: Battle of Earth: T'Challa takes the Nano Gauntlet from Clint, is knocked down by Thanos' Double-Edged Sword, then charged by Thanos and saved by Wanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When the Guardians find Thor floating in space, Mantis senses how much pain he is in and uses her powers to wake him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardian who wakes Thor with her powers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Asgardian Mantis wakes, sensing his pain.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Thor travels with the Guardians, and Mantis and Quill ask him to help fight Habooska's army on Indigarr. He says goodbye to her when the Guardians fly off without him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian Thor travels with. He says goodbye when they part ways.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The god who travels with the Guardians for a while.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: The Guardians pick Thor up at New Asgard, and when he and Quill argue over who leads, Mantis joins in and agrees they should settle it with knives.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who joins the banter when Thor comes aboard.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Asgardian who joins the Guardians at New Asgard.

their_evidence: After Tony's funeral the Guardians fly to New Asgard and pick up Thor; in the banter over who is leader Mantis agrees with Rocket that they use knives (quote: 'Oh, yes, please use knives').

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Rhodes and Thor are fellow Avengers. At the party in Avengers Tower, Thor is unimpressed by Rhodes's war story, and they fight side by side against Ultron in Sokovia.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger. Unimpressed by Rhodes's war story, but fights beside him in Sokovia.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger, beside Thor against Ultron in Sokovia.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Rhodes and Thor join the strike on Thanos at the Garden. When Rhodes doubts his claim that the Stones are gone, Nebula vouches for him, and Thor beheads him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger on the strike against Thanos at the Garden.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger on the strike at the Garden, where Thor beheads Thanos.

their_evidence: The remaining Avengers, including Rhodes and Thor, ambush Thanos at the Garden; Rhodes suspects Thanos is lying about destroying the Stones, Nebula vouches for him, and Thor beheads him. Both later take part in the Time Heist planning at the compound.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: The Guardians pull Thor from the wreck of his ship, and Drax tells him that Gamora is the adopted daughter of Thanos. Gamora explains that Thanos means to use the Infinity Stones to wipe out half of all life.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Thanos' adopted daughter, who warns Thor what the Stones are for.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Asgardian the Guardians rescue, whom Gamora warns about Thanos's plan.

question: Gamora's desc reads 'A Gamora from 2014', but the tie's only stage is the original Gamora in Infinity War. Is this tie on the right Gamora file?

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Rumlow and Sitwell are both HYDRA agents hidden inside S.H.I.E.L.D. When Steve is branded a fugitive, Sitwell runs the operation and sends Rumlow's STRIKE team to capture him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow HYDRA mole, who sends Rumlow's team after Steve.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA STRIKE leader Sitwell sends to capture Steve.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: In 2012 New York, Sitwell and Rumlow's STRIKE team take Loki's scepter to move it for HYDRA. When Steve asks for it, Rumlow refuses, but Sitwell hands it over after Steve whispers "Hail Hydra."
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow HYDRA mole moving the scepter with Rumlow's team in 2012.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The STRIKE leader beside Sitwell as they move the scepter in 2012.

their_evidence: Time heist at Stark Tower, 2012: Sitwell collects the scepter with the STRIKE team, reports to Pierce in the elevator; Rumlow tells Steve handing it over is not an option; Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra' and Sitwell gives it to him. Wikipedia plot: 'Rogers retrieves the Mind Stone from Hydra sleeper agents.'

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Ayo serves in the Dora Milaje as T'Challa's security chief and nearly comes to blows with Natasha in Berlin to protect him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The man Ayo guards as security chief, nearly fighting Natasha for him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's security chief, who nearly fights Natasha to protect him.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When Erik Killmonger takes the throne, Ayo is bound to serve him for a time. She returns to T'Challa's side once he comes back alive.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ayo's king, whose side she returns to once he is back.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's guard, bound to Killmonger for a time, back once T'Challa returns.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Ayo stands with T'Challa and the Dora Milaje as he welcomes the Avengers to Wakanda. She stays behind to guard Shuri while he leads the defense against Thanos's army.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ayo's king. She guards Shuri while he leads Wakanda's defense.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's guard, who protects Shuri during the battle.

their_evidence: Ayo is present with T'Challa and the Dora when the Avengers arrive in Birnin Zana, then stays behind to protect Shuri and fights Corvus Glaive in the lab (Avengers: Infinity War).

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: The Hulk ends Loki's rampage in Stark Tower by smashing him into the floor and calling him a puny god.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The puny god the Hulk smashes into the floor.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Smashes Loki into the floor and calls him a puny god.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: When they meet again on Sakaar, Loki is less than thrilled to see the Hulk, but the two end up on the same side in the fight to save Asgard's people.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An old foe, met again on Sakaar, now on Bruce's side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An old foe Loki is unhappy to see on Sakaar, now on the same side.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Aboard the Statesman, Loki stalls Thanos and tells him they have a Hulk, and the Hulk springs from hiding to attack Thanos.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Stalls Thanos so the Hulk can ambush him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Attacks Thanos on Loki's cue aboard the Statesman.

their_evidence: Loki's 'we have a Hulk' is the signal for the Hulk to spring from hiding and tackle Thanos on the Statesman.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Bruce Banner fights beside Steve Rogers as one of the first Avengers, and in New York Steve trusts him to unleash the Hulk on cue.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow first Avenger, who trusts Bruce to unleash the Hulk.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow first Avenger Steve trusts to unleash the Hulk.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they plan the Time Heist together, and Steve volunteers to return the Stones that Bruce used to undo the Snap.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend planning the Time Heist with Bruce, who returns the Stones.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend planning the Time Heist, whose used Stones Steve returns.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Bruce calls Steve to warn him that Thanos is coming for Vision, then rejoins him at the Avengers Compound. They fight side by side in Wakanda, where Bruce points Thanos out to him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Bruce calls for help, then fights beside in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who warns Steve about Thanos and fights beside him.

their_evidence: Banner finds the phone Rogers left Stark and calls him about the threat to Vision, reunites with him at the Compound, fights in Wakanda and tells him 'Cap. That's him.'

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: When the Hulk breaks loose on the Helicarrier he fights Thor, but they end up side by side as Avengers in the Battle of New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Bruce fights, then stands beside in New York.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who fights Thor, then stands beside him in New York.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor finds the Hulk fighting as the Grandmaster's champion on Sakaar, and the two teammates become real friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who finds Bruce on Sakaar and becomes a real friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Thor finds fighting on Sakaar, now a real friend.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Thor watches Thanos beat the Hulk aboard the Statesman before Heimdall sends the Hulk away. Bruce thinks his friend is gone until Thor arrives in Wakanda and saves the outnumbered Avengers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce thinks lost, who saves him in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend beaten by Thanos beside Thor, overjoyed to see him in Wakanda.

their_evidence: On the Statesman Thor attacks Thanos after the Hulk is beaten; in Wakanda the Bifrost wipes out the Outriders mobbing Banner, Barnes, T'Challa and Rogers, and Banner is happy his friend survived.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner bond as fellow scientists aboard the Helicarrier and become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow scientist and close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow scientist and close friend.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Together they build Ultron from the code they find in Loki's scepter, and after Ultron turns on them they create Vision.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bruce's friend and partner in building Ultron, then Vision.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's friend and partner in building Ultron, then Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they work together on the Time Heist, and Bruce wears the gauntlet Tony helps build to undo the Snap.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bruce's friend, whose gauntlet he wears to undo the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's friend, who wears the gauntlet Tony helped build to undo the Snap.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Bruce crash-lands on Earth and warns Tony about Thanos, pushing him to call Steve despite their split. Tony protects Bruce in New York when the Hulk refuses to come out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce warns about Thanos, who protects him in New York.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who warns Tony about Thanos and pushes him to call Steve.

their_evidence: Banner reunites with Stark via Strange's portal, tells him about Thanos, convinces him to call Rogers, and Stark fights Cull Obsidian to protect him while the Hulk won't come out.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Bruce Banner helps Tony Stark upload J.A.R.V.I.S. into the synthetic body that becomes Vision. Vision then fights beside him as a fellow Avenger.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The synthetic being Bruce helps create, now a fellow Avenger.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Vision's creators, now a fellow Avenger.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Vision offers to die to destroy the Mind Stone, Bruce argues he is more than the Stone and proposes removing it instead. He then fights in Wakanda to protect Vision.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Bruce refuses to let die for the Mind Stone.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Argues Vision is more than the Stone and fights to protect him.

their_evidence: At the Avengers Compound Banner proposes removing the stone, saying Vision is more than it since he, Stark, Ultron and J.A.R.V.I.S. all contributed; he later fights Cull Obsidian and Glaive to defend Vision in Wakanda.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson fights the Winter Soldier in Washington while helping Steve Rogers bring down HYDRA.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Steve's friend. Fights Bucky, as the Winter Soldier, while helping bring down HYDRA.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier. Sam fights him in Washington while helping Steve.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sam Wilson sides with Steve Rogers to protect Bucky Barnes after the Vienna bombing. The two bicker constantly while they fight together against Tony Stark's side.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sides with Steve to protect Bucky after Vienna. They bicker nonstop.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's old friend, whom Sam helps protect after Vienna. They bicker nonstop.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#2
stages.text: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes team up to hunt the Flag Smashers, bickering all the way.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's partner against the Flag Smashers. They bicker nonstop.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Sam's partner against the Flag Smashers. They bicker nonstop.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier#5
stages.text: In Louisiana, Bucky helps Sam fix his family's boat, and the two agree to move on from their pasts and work together as real friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's partner against the Flag Smashers, and now a true friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Sam's partner. The bickering turns into real friendship.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Bucky and Sam stand watch together in Wakanda as Thanos's dropships crash into the city's dome, then fight in the battle that follows.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Stands watch with Bucky as Thanos's ships hit Wakanda's dome.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Stands watch with Sam as Thanos's ships hit Wakanda's dome.

their_evidence: While the Avengers meet Shuri, Barnes and Falcon stand outside and watch the dropships crash into Wakanda's protective dome before the Battle of Wakanda.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Bucky Barnes and Steve Rogers are best friends from their childhood in Brooklyn. Bucky fights at Steve's side with the Howling Commandos until he falls from Zola's train.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend since Brooklyn. Bucky fights at his side until falling from Zola's train.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend since Brooklyn. A Howling Commando until falling from Zola's train.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: HYDRA has turned Bucky into the Winter Soldier, and he no longer knows Steve when they clash in Washington. Steve refuses to fight him on the helicarrier, and Bucky pulls him out of the river.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend, whom Bucky no longer remembers. Bucky pulls him from the river.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, now HYDRA's Winter Soldier. No longer knows Steve.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Steve Rogers stands by Bucky Barnes after he is framed for the Vienna bombing, protecting him even against Tony Stark.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend. Protects him after the Vienna frame-up, even against Tony.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, framed for Vienna. Steve protects him, even against Tony.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Before Steve Rogers takes the Infinity Stones back to their own times, Bucky Barnes says goodbye to him, knowing his best friend will not come back. Steve stays in the past to live out his life.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend since Brooklyn. Says goodbye before staying in the past.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, who sees him off before he stays in the past.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Steve and Bucky reunite with a hug in Wakanda and fight side by side against Thanos's army. After the Snap, Bucky calls out to Steve as he turns to dust.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend, reunited in Wakanda. Bucky turns to dust calling his name.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, who fades to dust calling his name.

their_evidence: Barnes greets the Avengers in Wakanda and hugs Rogers ('How you been, Buck?'), fights in the Battle of Wakanda, and says 'Steve?' before disintegrating.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax first tries to kill Gamora in the Kyln to avenge his family, since she served Ronan. Once he learns she has turned on Ronan and Thanos, they become teammates and friends in the Guardians.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Once Drax's target for revenge, then a teammate and friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tries to kill Gamora, then becomes a teammate and friend.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Drax, joins him and the Guardians to break into the Orgoscope for Rocket's code, and she helps him walk back to the ship after the fight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Gamora from 2014 who never knew Drax. Helps him on the mission to save Rocket.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she helps on the mission to save Rocket.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Aboard the Benatar, Drax tells Thor that Gamora is Thanos's daughter. On Knowhere, he yells at Thanos for taking her captive, and Thanos breaks him into pieces.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Drax tries to save from Thanos on Knowhere.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tells Thor she is Thanos's daughter. Struck down trying to save her.

their_evidence: Benatar: Drax reveals to Thor that Gamora is Thanos's adopted daughter. Knowhere: Drax yells at Thanos for taking Gamora captive and Thanos incapacitates him with the Reality Stone, turning him to pieces.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Groot break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. When the regrown Groot dances behind Drax's back, he freezes every time Drax looks his way.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Baby Groot freezes whenever Drax looks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Groot dances behind his back.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: When Groot swears at Quill over his game aboard the Benatar, Drax and the rest of the crew react in shock.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teenage teammate whose swearing shocks Drax and the crew.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who reacts in shock when Groot swears at Quill.

their_evidence: Benatar: Quill tells Groot to put his game away, Groot answers 'I am Groot' rudely and the crew (dialogue credited to Star-Lord, Groot, Gamora, Drax and Rocket) reacts in an uproar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis bonds with Drax on Ego's planet and reveals Ego's true plan to him. The two become best friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's best friend. Reveals Ego's plan to him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Mantis's best friend. They bond on Ego's planet.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: On Knowhere, Mantis puts Drax to sleep to stop him charging Thanos too soon. On Titan, Drax watches her fade away in the Snap before he fades too.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Puts Drax to sleep on Knowhere. Fades before his eyes on Titan.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Mantis puts to sleep on Knowhere. Fades right after her on Titan.

their_evidence: Knowhere: Mantis uses her powers to make Drax sleep when he charges Thanos early. Titan: Mantis says something is happening and disintegrates; Drax watches in alarm and disintegrates next.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Quill first meet as inmates in the Kyln and become founding Guardians. Drax looks out for Quill like a brother.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Drax looks out for him like a brother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Looks out for Quill like a brother.

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: On Knowhere, Quill tries to hold Drax back from charging Thanos too soon. On Titan, Drax calls out to Quill as he fades away in the Snap.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Holds Drax back on Knowhere. The one Drax calls out to as he fades.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Charges Thanos too soon on Knowhere. Calls out to Quill as he fades.

their_evidence: Knowhere: 'Drax, wait! Not yet' as Quill tries to restrain him. Titan: Drax's last word is 'Quill?' as he disintegrates.
